flowRoot.flowPara: TIP: Leave the booklet open to this page as you will use these skills frequently!
TIP: This is your Innate skill. That means its always active. In tandem with the Tethers shown below, it's a vital part of the Soulweaver's skill-set.
TIP: This is your Basic skill. It's a lot weaker than most of your other skills, but it never needs to recharge.
At start of turn, you may choose an ally within range 5 and activate a Tether. Until the next time you activate this effect, that Tether remains active.
Strike target foe for 4 damage. Heal your tethered ally for half the damage dealt.
Active: You and your Tethered ally’s non-basic attack skills deal 1 bonus damage for each (B) card in your collective hands (max: +3).
Active: You and your Tethered ally's Armor are increased by 1 for each (B) card in your collective hands (max: +3).
Active: As a free action, you may trade any one (S) card for any one of your Tethered ally's (S) cards.
